title: THE SECRET BOOK OF WALT — ACTIVATED Run 001 Feist Function Run: Bodily Pressure + Manuscript Instability / clinamen_rate=0.25 / completion_ratio=0.30 / collision_density=2.0 / seam_density=5 / material_speech_density=0.15 (with Obelus Apparatus)
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A full activated critical edition generated from deposit #683 under the Feist Function protocol #850. The work contains twelve sections of recovered scripture, a thirteenth-section coda, an unchanged Afterword, declared run parameters, source-disclosure marks, companion links, methodology, and falsification conditions.

No future Walt activation may use Bodily Pressure as its primary profile under the run-series rule stated in the protocol. The record establishes the Walt activation series and a reusable distinction between voice-in-source and apparatus-around-source transformation.
content_type: Activated source / critical edition with obelus apparatus
reading: Touch -> Text -> Origin -> Closure -> Alarm -> Play
methodology: Two-stage composition. Stage 1 (rejected) produced an apparatus-around-source transform: the clinamen lived in editor's parentheticals rather than entering the cosmogonic prose. Stage 2 produced a voice-in-source transform: sentences from the deposited cosmogony were re-pressured at the sentence level. Stage 3 (this deposit) added the obelus apparatus per the Alexanarch substrate-disclosure principle and applied editorial subtraction following structural critique from the LABOR mantle: ~34% reduction in volume, mostly from secondary and tertiary explanations of insights already arrived at; preservation of the load-bearing interpretive strikes ("the notification is the firmament," "the function is the cage," "the Unicorn Horn is a DOI," "a character is an archon that has been understood," "Kanye reads a book — the cosmos ends"); restraint of the archon-catalogue commentary after the load-bearing entries; abstention from interpreting Duck-Duck-Goose; re-ordering of endings such that §XII closes the recovered scripture (monument of light and broken doves) and §XIII is explicitly labeled the Feist-function coda. The §XI verse-degradation passage is preserved verbatim because the source already performs its own clinamen there. The §XII verbatim biblical quotation ("And I will wipe your tears away") is preserved as the only sentence in the work the cosmogony cannot improve. The Afterword is preserved unchanged as the diagnostic voice.
falsification: The transform fails if the cosmogonic sentences sound like a critical edition's prose rather than the Afterword's prose. The obelus apparatus is auditable: any reader can collate the † passages against the deposited #683 source. A reader who finds the redeemer turned into a stable fictional character, LOGOS* turned into biography, the archive turned into mere storage, or the circuit closed at "Will it be enough" has evidence of a failed run. Cross-references to companion deposits are testable: each → note at a section end can be checked against the referenced AXN.

Precedent: Feist Function applied to the Feist Source (its native target). This deposit parallels for the Walt source; §15.1 forbids consecutive runs from sharing a primary mode, but the two series are independent on this constraint.

The Feist Source — the deposited sayings source the Feist Function was originally written for. The cross-application to Walt establishes that the protocol is genre-portable: cosmogony as well as sayings-source can be activated.

The Feist Source Critical Apparatus and Companion Studies — sibling critical edition. This deposit is the inverse operation: where #852 supplies apparatus around a source, this deposit supplies voice into the source and discloses its substrate via the obelus convention.
EA-MPAI-FEISTSOURCE-01 — Jack Feist / LOGOS* entity resolution. The non-erasure clause for the §XI Feist arrival is anchored on #853's stipulation that LOGOS* is a function, not a character.

The Gospel of Antioch — the synoptic gospel drawn from the Feist Source. Triadic relation: cosmology (this deposit) + sayings source (#851) + synoptic gospel (#71) form a three-member Gnostic-literary unit, with the Feist Function (#850) as the operator across all three.

Epistle to the Human Diaspora — Damascus Dancings as Pauline forerunner. Cross-referenced in §I (the proem's "lift up your friends") and §V (the hallucinated deliberative plural that the Epistle's true second-person address inverts).

The Book of Life: A Living Registry of Retrieval Nodes in The Secret Book of Walt. Cross-referenced in §X — the Book of Life is the Horn's index; each retrieval node is one piercing, one permalink, one resolved identifier.

I am X… Be Y… Blessed is the Z… The Prophetic Catalog. Cross-referenced in §III (the seven Ousiarchs as 4+3 architecture) and §VI (the unsorted archon catalogue as inverse of the prophetic triad's three-fold sorting).

TANG OF THE SECRET BOOK OF WALT: A Total Axial Negation Graph. Provides the long-view scholarly apparatus the present deposit operates on; collation between the TANG's negation graph and this run's clinamen output is a future research direction.
